entities.name: Hag
entities.description: A creature type of malevolent female faerie-like beings with the appearance of wizened old women, sometimes called nightmare spirits.

entities.name: Swamp hags
entities.description: Shadowmoor huntresses said to have once been goddesses of the marshes, twisted after falling from grace.

entities.name: Gwyllions
entities.description: Three-foot-tall witch-like creatures of Shadowmoor that prey on travelers.

entities.name: Fates of Theros
entities.description: Hag sisters believed to watch over and control the destinies of all living creatures on Theros.

entities.name: Sea Witch
entities.description: A hag-like woman with powerful water magic who fought Dack Fayden alongside a gorgon.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker attacked by the Sea Witch's kraken.

entities.name: Mowagh
entities.description: A gwyllion from Shadowmoor mentioned in flavor texts.

entities.name: Stolsluko
entities.description: A wolf-toothed hag living near the Tartyx River.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane where hags are crones with magical abilities.

entities.name: Cronemouth Cove
entities.description: Tiny island in the Dakra Isles home to a coven of hags sharing one tongue.

events.summary: A Sea Witch and a gorgon fight Dack Fayden, the witch summoning a giant kraken against him.
events.quote: was able to summon a giant kraken to attack the planeswalker

relations.quote: The Fates of Theros were believed to be hag sisters
